notes: today is Tuesday 2026-10-06, 10:00 local time; the scale is S=15, M=60, L=180 minutes
extracted is empty unless a case sets it: the eval measures what the model finds on its own, while in the app the rule-based parser fills common dates first
expected holds the validated answer the app should get: dates only when the text names one specific day, null for vague periods and past days
fragments document the expected source text and are not scored; only sizes, dates and deadline times are
dates follow the resolution rules of the enrich prompt: a bare weekday is the nearest one from today on, 'next <weekday>' is that day of next week, the end of the week is Friday
